title: Charge!
description: Every pawn on border sectors charges 1 sector closer to the center.

title: Mental Force Field
description: Pawns at distance 1 from Jakub are pushed further away. Epicenter pawns do not move. Pushed out of board pawns are killed (-1 pts to general).

title: Bardak Cowardice
description: Lonely Bardaks fleeing. Move them to adjacent sectors with the most other pawns. If tied (V->W->G) or empty, they desert the board (-1 pts to general).

title: Jakub's Gravity
description: Every pawn at distance 3 or more from Jakub is pulled 1 sector closer to him.

title: Crimson Convergence
description: All Vampires on the board migrate directly to the sector containing Jakub.

title: Alpha's Call
description: Lonely Werewolves are pulled 1 sector closer to the largest pack of Werewolves.

title: Lunar Alignment
description: Lonely Werewolves are pulled 1 sector closer to the nearest Werewolf pack.

title: Vampire Bite
description: In every sector with at least one Vampire and one Bardak, a Vampire bites a Bardak, transforming them. If any transformation occurs, Jakub's anger towards Bardaks drops to 0.

title: Pack Infection (Rows)
description: Finds row with most Werewolves and at least 1 Bardak. Up to Werewolf count are transformed, remaining flee to Jakub. Werewolves are redistributed. If no match, Werewolf anger drops to 0 and Bardak anger increases by 5.

title: Pack Infection (Columns)
description: Finds column with most Werewolves and at least 1 Bardak. Up to Werewolf count are transformed, remaining flee to Jakub. Werewolves are redistributed. If no match, Werewolf anger drops to 0 and Bardak anger increases by 5.

title: Bloody Moon
description: Vampires are agitated. Jakub's anger towards Vampires increases by 3.

title: Full Moon
description: Werewolves are howling. Jakub's anger towards Werewolves increases by 3.

title: Cold Breeze
description: Ghosts are restless. Jakub's anger towards Ghosts increases by 3.

title: Drunk Fest
description: Bardaks are partying. Jakub's anger towards Bardaks increases by 3.

title: Holy Water
description: Vampires are suppressed. Jakub's anger towards Vampires decreases by 1.

title: Silver Dust
description: Werewolves are weakened. Jakub's anger towards Werewolves decreases by 1.

title: Exorcism
description: Ghosts are banished. Jakub's anger towards Ghosts decreases by 1.

title: Morning After
description: Bardaks have a hangover. Jakub's anger towards Bardaks decreases by 1.

title: General Annoyance
description: Jakub is annoyed by everyone. Anger towards all races increases by 1.

title: Distraction
description: Jakub found a bottle of Samogon. Anger towards all races decreases by 1.

title: Ancient Awakening
description: Ancient vampires awaken. Total Vampire limit increases by 3.

title: Blood Call
description: More vampires join the fray. Total Vampire limit increases by 2.

title: Alpha's Call
description: The pack grows. Total Werewolf limit increases by 2.

title: Night Terrors
description: Creatures of the night are more numerous. Werewolf and Ghost limits increase by 1.

title: Ethereal Carnival
description: A strange celebration. Ghost limit increases by 1 and Bardak limit by 2.

title: Sunlight Leak
description: Unprotected basements. Total Vampire limit decreases by 1.

title: Hunter Traps
description: Steel jaws in the woods. Total Werewolf limit decreases by 2.

title: Cursed Soil
description: The land itself rejects the undead. Werewolf limit decreases by 1 and Ghost limit by 2.

title: Divine Barrier
description: Holy presence weakens the spirits. Total Ghost limit decreases by 3.

title: City Lockdown
description: Police and exorcists are active. Ghost and Bardak limits decrease by 2.

title: Mass Arrest
description: The tavern was raided. Total Bardak limit decreases by 5.

title: Corner Sweep
description: Jakub scouts the perimeter. Every pawn in the 4 corners of the board is eliminated.

title: Inner Sanctum Breach
description: Jakub breaks through the inner defenses. Pawns at (1,1), (1,4), (4,1), and (4,4) are eliminated.

title: Side Tall Patrol
description: Jakub patrols the tall side borders. Pawns along the vertical edges are eliminated.

title: Wide Border Raid
description: Jakub raids the wide horizontal borders. Pawns along the horizontal edges are eliminated.

title: Center board Cleansing
description: Jakub focuses his wrath on the heart of the board. All pawns in the 4 central regions are eliminated.

title: Supply Drop
description: A mysterious benefactor sends supplies. Each player receives 1 extra set.

title: Logistics Mastery
description: Improved supply lines. Each player receives 2 extra sets.

title: Quiet Night
description: Nothing happens tonight.

title: Tactical Relocation
description: Local skirmish shifts. Move all pawns from (0,0) to (2,2).

title: Sudden Panic
description: Fleeing the outskirts. Move all pawns from (5,5) to (3,3).

title: Whirlwind
description: A mystical wind blows. Move all pawns from (0,5) to (1,4).

title: Give up the Ghost
description: Look for any border sector with only Bardaks. One of those Bardaks ('wyzionoł ducha') is transformed into a Ghost. Decreases Bardak total count, increases Ghost total count. If any transformation occurred, Jakub's anger towards Bardaks drops to 0. If no transformation occurred, anger for Bardaks increases by 5.
